experiences.name: Sunset Catamaran Cruise
experiences.description: Board a catamaran for a scenic sunset cruise along the Caribbean coastline. Enjoy open bar, snorkeling stops at a reef, and breathtaking views of the Cancun skyline as the sun dips below the horizon. A romantic and memorable way to experience the sea from a different perspective.

experiences.location: Playa Tortugas, Hotel Zone (Zona Hotelera), Cancun

trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Cancun International Airport at 11:00 AM on Flight AA. Clear customs, collect luggage, and take the affordable ADO bus from the airport to the Hotel Zone (around $10 USD) instead of a taxi to save money. Check in to Cancun Beach Resort and get settled.
day_by_day.afternoon: After check-in, take a short walk to the nearest public beach access point to get your first feel of the Caribbean. Relax on the sand, take a dip in the turquoise water, and unwind from your travels. No entrance fee required at public beach access points.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along Boulevard Kukulcan in the Hotel Zone to explore the area. Visit a local convenience store (OXXO) to stock up on snacks and drinks for the room to save on daily costs.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the airport before or after landing — look for local bakeries or grab a torta from an airport food stand (~$5 USD).
meals.lunch: Pick up tacos or a torta from a street food vendor near the Hotel Zone bus stop (~$4-6 USD).
meals.dinner: Eat at El Fish Fritanga or a similar local seafood spot near the Hotel Zone offering budget-friendly fish tacos and ceviche (~$8-12 USD).

day_by_day.notes: The ADO bus from the airport is the most budget-friendly option (~$10 USD vs $30-50 for a taxi). Ask the hotel about free amenities and any included breakfast to maximize savings.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Playa Delfines Beach for a full morning of sun and sand. This is one of Cancun's most beautiful and uncrowded public beaches — and it's completely FREE. Arrive early to claim a great spot. Bring your own water and snacks from the hotel to avoid overpriced beach vendors.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue enjoying Playa Delfines. Take photos at the iconic Cancun sign, swim in the clear Caribbean waters, and relax on the white sand. Explore the beach in both directions on foot.
day_by_day.evening: Take the public bus (Route 1, ~$0.80 USD) back toward the hotel area. Walk along the lagoon side of Boulevard Kukulcan at sunset for beautiful views.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the hotel if breakfast is included, or grab fresh fruit and yogurt from a nearby OXXO or grocery store (~$3-5 USD).
meals.lunch: Pack a lunch from the hotel or pick up tortas and agua frescas from a local market before heading to the beach (~$4-6 USD).
meals.dinner: Try Tacos y Mariscos El Rinconcito or a similar local taqueria near the Hotel Zone for budget tacos and fresh seafood (~$7-10 USD).

day_by_day.notes: Playa Delfines is free and accessible via the public R-1 bus along Boulevard Kukulcan. Bring sunscreen, a reusable water bottle, and snacks to avoid spending extra money at the beach.

day_by_day.morning: Take the public bus to downtown Cancun (El Centro) to explore the local side of the city. Visit Mercado 28, a colorful local market where you can browse handmade souvenirs, hammocks, and crafts at much lower prices than the Hotel Zone. Practice your bargaining skills!
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Parque Las Palapas, a lively public park in downtown Cancun where locals gather. Enjoy the free entertainment, street performers, and the vibrant atmosphere. Browse the surrounding streets for local shops.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the Hotel Zone via public bus. Walk along the lagoon-facing side of the boulevard to catch the sunset over Nichupte Lagoon — completely free and stunning.

meals.breakfast: Eat at a local comedor (small diner) in the Hotel Zone or hotel for a hearty Mexican breakfast of eggs, beans, and tortillas (~$4-6 USD).
meals.lunch: Eat at Mercado 28's food court — some of the best and most affordable local food in Cancun. Try poc chuc, cochinita pibil, or sopa de lima (~$5-8 USD).
meals.dinner: Grab street tacos near Parque Las Palapas before heading back, or find a local restaurant near the hotel for grilled fish or chicken with rice and beans (~$8-12 USD).

day_by_day.notes: The public bus to downtown (El Centro) costs about $0.80 USD each way. Mercado 28 is a great place to buy souvenirs at a fraction of Hotel Zone prices — always negotiate!

day_by_day.morning: Spend the morning at the Playa Tortugas Beach Club Day Pass experience. Playa Tortugas is one of the most popular and lively beaches in the Hotel Zone. The day pass typically includes access to beach chairs, umbrellas, and sometimes food and drink credits — check current pricing for the best deal.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue enjoying Playa Tortugas Beach Club. Take advantage of the calmer lagoon-side waters if available, try water activities, or simply relax and soak up the atmosphere of this iconic Cancun beach.
day_by_day.evening: Walk or take the bus to the nearby La Isla Shopping Village to window shop and enjoy the waterfront canal setting for free. Look for happy hour specials at nearby bars if your budget allows.

meals.breakfast: Eat a filling breakfast at the hotel or grab pan dulce (Mexican sweet bread) and coffee from a local bakery (~$2-4 USD) before heading to the beach.
meals.lunch: Use any food/drink credit included with the Playa Tortugas day pass, or bring your own snacks and water to minimize spending at the beach club.
meals.dinner: Head to a local seafood restaurant near the Hotel Zone such as El Cejas or a similar spot for fresh ceviche and grilled fish at reasonable prices (~$10-14 USD).

day_by_day.notes: Compare Playa Tortugas Beach Club day pass prices in advance and look for online deals or discounts. Some passes include food/drink credits that make them more cost-effective. Arrive early to get the best beach chairs.

day_by_day.morning: Explore a different public beach — head to Playa Caracol or Playa Langosta, both free public beaches in the Hotel Zone with calm, clear waters. These are great for snorkeling if you brought or can rent inexpensive gear.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the small but interesting Museo Maya de Cancun (Cancun Mayan Museum), which features impressive Mayan artifacts and is very affordable (~$4-5 USD entry). Located right in the Hotel Zone, it's easy to reach by bus.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a leisurely sunset walk along the beach or the hotel zone strip. Look for happy hour deals at local bars or grab a cold beer from a convenience store and enjoy it on a public beach (check local rules).

meals.breakfast: Prepare a simple breakfast with groceries purchased earlier in the trip — fruit, yogurt, and granola from a local store (~$2-3 USD).
meals.lunch: Grab fresh ceviche tostadas from a beachside vendor or a nearby local restaurant (~$5-8 USD).
meals.dinner: Treat yourself slightly on this second-to-last evening — try a local restaurant with a set menu (comida corrida) offering soup, main course, and drink for a fixed affordable price (~$8-12 USD).

day_by_day.notes: The Museo Maya de Cancun is one of the best value attractions in the Hotel Zone, offering genuine cultural insight. Sunday entry is free for Mexican nationals — not applicable here but worth knowing for future visits.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy one final morning at your favorite beach discovered during the trip — whether that's Playa Delfines, Playa Caracol, or the hotel beach. Take a last swim in the Caribbean and soak in the beautiful scenery.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the hotel to pack up, check out, and store luggage with the front desk if needed. Take a final stroll through the Hotel Zone, pick up any last-minute souvenirs from Mercado 28 or local shops, and enjoy a farewell meal.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Cancun International Airport using the affordable ADO bus (~$10 USD). Arrive at least 2-3 hours before your departure flight. Reflect on an amazing budget-friendly Cancun adventure!

meals.breakfast: Have a final full breakfast at the hotel (if included) or at a nearby local spot — enjoy chilaquiles or huevos rancheros for a classic Mexican send-off (~$5-7 USD).
meals.lunch: Grab a final round of tacos or a torta from a local vendor near the hotel before heading to the airport (~$4-6 USD).
meals.dinner: Eat at the airport if your flight is in the evening, or enjoy a farewell dinner near the Hotel Zone before departing — keep it simple and budget-friendly (~$8-12 USD).

day_by_day.notes: Check out time is typically 11 AM or 12 PM — confirm with the hotel. The ADO bus to the airport departs regularly from stops along Boulevard Kukulcan and is far cheaper than taxis or private transfers. Keep some pesos on hand for bus fare and tips.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Cancun International Airport at 11:00 AM on Flight AA. Clear customs, collect luggage, and arrange airport transfer to Cancun Beach Resort. Check-in and settle into your room (early check-in may be available; confirm with hotel in advance).
day_by_day.afternoon: After freshening up, take a leisurely stroll to the nearest hotel zone beach for a relaxed first afternoon. Dip your toes in the Caribbean Sea, get oriented with the Hotel Zone (Zona Hotelera), and explore the surroundings on foot. Visit a nearby convenience store or market to pick up essentials.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a welcome dinner at a mid-range restaurant in the Hotel Zone. Try La Habichuela Downtown or a nearby seafood spot to sample local Yucatecan cuisine and fresh catch of the day.

meals.breakfast: Grab a light snack or coffee at the airport before or after landing
meals.lunch: Casual beachside taco stand or hotel restaurant for a quick and affordable first meal in Cancun
meals.dinner: La Habichuela or similar mid-range Yucatecan/seafood restaurant in the Hotel Zone — budget around $20–35 USD per person

day_by_day.notes: Since arrival is at 11:00 AM, keep Day 1 light. Confirm hotel check-in time in advance. Stay hydrated — the Cancun sun can be intense even in March. Exchange some cash or locate a nearby ATM for local expenses.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Playa Delfines Beach Day — one of Cancun's most beautiful and uncrowded public beaches. Arrive early (around 9:00 AM) to secure a great spot. Enjoy swimming, sunbathing, and the iconic Cancun sign for photos. Playa Delfines is free to access and less crowded than hotel zone beaches.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue relaxing at Playa Delfines or explore the nearby area. Walk along the shoreline and take in the turquoise waters. Around 2:00 PM, head back toward the Hotel Zone and visit a local market or shopping plaza like La Isla Shopping Village for a browse.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy dinner at a mid-range restaurant in the Hotel Zone. Try Labná or a similar spot specializing in traditional Mexican cuisine. Afterward, take an evening walk along Kukulcán Boulevard to enjoy the lively Hotel Zone atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the hotel or a nearby café — try chilaquiles or huevos rancheros for an authentic start
meals.lunch: Pack a light lunch or grab street tacos and fresh fruit near Playa Delfines to keep costs low
meals.dinner: Labná Restaurant or similar mid-range Mexican restaurant — budget around $20–35 USD per person

day_by_day.notes: Playa Delfines is a public beach with no beach clubs, so bring your own towels, sunscreen, and water. It is located at the southern end of the Hotel Zone — take the R-1 bus along Kukulcán Boulevard for an affordable and easy ride (about 12 MXN each way).

day_by_day.morning: Full-day experience: Isla Mujeres Snorkeling & Beach Tour. Depart early (around 8:30–9:00 AM) from Puerto Juárez ferry terminal to Isla Mujeres. Spend the morning snorkeling in the crystal-clear Caribbean waters around the island, exploring colorful coral reefs and tropical fish.
day_by_day.afternoon: After snorkeling, explore the charming town of Isla Mujeres on foot or by golf cart rental. Visit Playa Norte, consistently rated one of the best beaches in Mexico, with calm turquoise waters perfect for swimming. Enjoy lunch at a beachfront restaurant on the island.
day_by_day.evening: Take the return ferry back to Cancun in the late afternoon (around 5:00–6:00 PM). Freshen up at the hotel and enjoy a relaxed dinner close to the resort. Opt for a casual beach bar or restaurant for a low-key evening after a full day.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the hotel before departure — make sure to fuel up before a full day of water activities
meals.lunch: Beachfront seafood lunch on Isla Mujeres — try fresh ceviche, grilled fish tacos, or shrimp at a local restaurant on Playa Norte — budget around $15–25 USD
meals.dinner: Casual dinner near the hotel — try Tacos y Mariscos El Pata or a similar local spot for affordable and authentic Mexican seafood

day_by_day.notes: Book the Isla Mujeres Snorkeling & Beach Tour in advance, especially during March which is peak season. Round-trip ferry tickets from Puerto Juárez cost approximately $10–15 USD. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a waterproof bag, and a light cover-up. Golf cart rentals on the island run about $40–50 USD for a half day and are a fun way to explore.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day experience: Xel-Ha Eco Water Park & Snorkeling. Depart by shuttle or bus toward Xel-Ha, located about 75 miles south of Cancun (approximately 1.5-hour drive). Arrive when the park opens around 8:30–9:00 AM to maximize your time. Begin exploring the natural inlet where freshwater and saltwater meet, snorkeling through mangroves and spotting diverse marine life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue enjoying Xel-Ha's all-inclusive offerings — cliff jumping, floating down the lazy river, hammocks in the water, and exploring the jungle trails. Take advantage of the included food and drinks (the all-inclusive package covers meals, snacks, and beverages throughout the day).
day_by_day.evening: Return to Cancun in the late afternoon (around 5:00–6:00 PM). After a full day of activity, enjoy a relaxed dinner at a mid-range restaurant in the Hotel Zone. Try Harry's Prime Steakhouse & Raw Bar or similar for a slightly elevated but still mid-range dining experience as a treat.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at the hotel before departure — Xel-Ha's all-inclusive package includes food from mid-morning onward
meals.lunch: Included in Xel-Ha's all-inclusive entry — enjoy fresh seafood, Mexican dishes, and snacks at the park's restaurants
meals.dinner: Mid-range dinner in the Hotel Zone — budget around $25–40 USD per person for a slightly elevated experience after a long active day

day_by_day.notes: Xel-Ha is best booked in advance online for discounts — all-inclusive tickets typically run $80–110 USD per person. Wear your swimsuit under your clothes and bring reef-safe sunscreen (mandatory in the park). Water shoes are recommended. Book round-trip transportation from Cancun when purchasing tickets to simplify logistics.

day_by_day.morning: Playa Tortugas Beach Club Day Pass — spend a fun morning at one of the most popular and lively beaches in the Hotel Zone. Arrive around 9:00–10:00 AM to claim a beach chair and umbrella. Enjoy the energetic atmosphere, water sports rentals (jet skis, paddleboats), and the calm waters of Playa Tortugas.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue at the beach club through the afternoon, enjoying the pool, beach, and included amenities with your day pass. Around 3:00–4:00 PM, freshen up and get ready for the evening's highlight — the Sunset Catamaran Cruise.
day_by_day.evening: Board the Sunset Catamaran Cruise departing in the late afternoon/early evening (typically around 5:00–6:00 PM). Sail along the stunning Caribbean coastline, enjoy the open bar, snorkeling stop, and watch the spectacular Cancun sunset from the water. Return to shore around 8:00–9:00 PM in high spirits.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the hotel before heading to the beach club
meals.lunch: Lunch at Playa Tortugas Beach Club restaurant — food and drinks are typically available at mid-range prices with the day pass; budget around $20–30 USD
meals.dinner: Light dinner after the catamaran cruise — try a casual beachfront restaurant or taco spot near the Hotel Zone, as the catamaran typically includes snacks and drinks

day_by_day.notes: Playa Tortugas Beach Club Day Pass typically costs $30–60 USD and may include a food and drink credit — confirm inclusions when booking. Book the Sunset Catamaran Cruise in advance as it is very popular, especially on weekends; tickets are approximately $55–80 USD per person. Bring a light jacket or wrap for the catamaran as it can get breezy on the water after sunset.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Cancun — enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the hotel and take one last stroll on the beach. Pack your bags and check out of the hotel. If time allows before departure, visit a local artisan market such as Mercado 28 (Mercado de Artesanías) to pick up souvenirs — hand-crafted goods, hammocks, local spices, and Mayan-inspired crafts at negotiable prices.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, enjoy a final lunch at a beloved local spot. Head to the airport with ample time — aim to arrive at least 2.5–3 hours before your international departure. Reflect on a wonderful 6-day Cancun adventure.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Cancun International Airport. Safe travels!

meals.breakfast: Full breakfast at the hotel — enjoy a proper sit-down meal as a final treat before check-out
meals.lunch: Final lunch at a local favorite near Mercado 28 — try El Pescado Ciego or a nearby cocina económica for authentic, affordable Yucatecan food at $8–15 USD per person
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-flight meal depending on departure time

day_by_day.notes: Check your flight departure time carefully and plan your final day activities around it. Cancun airport can be busy during peak season — allow extra time for check-in and security. Keep some Mexican Pesos on hand for last-minute purchases at Mercado 28 where vendors prefer cash. Confirm hotel late check-out options if your flight departs in the evening.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Cancun International Airport at 11:00 AM on Flight AA. Private luxury transfer arranged to Cancun Beach Resort. Check-in and settle into your premium suite with ocean views. Enjoy a welcome amenity and familiarize yourself with the resort facilities.
day_by_day.afternoon: After freshening up, head down to the resort's private beach for a relaxed introduction to Cancun's stunning Caribbean coastline. Arrange a premium beach cabana with personalized butler service, refreshing cocktails, and a dip in the turquoise waters.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's rooftop or beachfront bar. Enjoy the golden hour over the Caribbean Sea before heading to dinner.

meals.breakfast: Skip or grab a light bite at the airport before landing
meals.lunch: Welcome lunch at the resort's signature beachfront restaurant — try fresh ceviche, grilled lobster tacos, and tropical fruit platters
meals.dinner: Dinner at La Fisheria or Harry's Prime Steakhouse & Raw Bar in the Hotel Zone — both offer premium menus with fresh seafood and fine cuts in an upscale atmosphere

day_by_day.notes: Arrival day is intentionally relaxed. Confirm all upcoming excursion bookings with the resort concierge upon check-in. Request a premium beach cabana reservation for the following morning.

day_by_day.morning: Start the day with a gourmet breakfast at the resort. Head to Playa Delfines Beach Day — one of Cancun's most breathtaking and uncrowded public beaches. Arrive early to secure a prime spot with stunning views of the Caribbean. Enjoy the calm, crystal-clear waters and the iconic Cancun sign for photos.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a rejuvenating afternoon. Book a 90-minute luxury spa treatment at the resort's premium spa — choose from a deep tissue massage, hot stone therapy, or a Caribbean-inspired body wrap. Follow with a refreshing dip in the resort pool.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's swim-up bar. Dress for a premium dinner experience at Porfirio's Cancun, a renowned upscale Mexican restaurant in the Hotel Zone offering elevated traditional cuisine with live music.

meals.breakfast: Full gourmet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — eggs benedict, fresh tropical fruits, smoked salmon, and premium coffee
meals.lunch: Light beachside lunch at Playa Delfines — bring a premium charcuterie picnic arranged by the resort concierge, or dine at a nearby upscale beach club
meals.dinner: Porfirio's Cancun — signature guacamole prepared tableside, grilled sea bass, premium margaritas, and live Latin music ambiance

day_by_day.notes: Playa Delfines is a public beach with no entry fee. Arrive before 9:30 AM to avoid crowds. Wear reef-safe sunscreen. Pre-book the spa treatment the evening before through the concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Early departure for the Isla Mujeres Snorkeling & Beach Tour. Take a private or premium ferry to the charming island of Isla Mujeres. Snorkel in the MUSA underwater museum or the vibrant coral reefs teeming with tropical fish, sea turtles, and rays in the crystal-clear Caribbean waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Isla Mujeres at leisure — stroll through the colorful downtown streets, browse artisan boutiques, and relax on the world-famous Playa Norte, consistently ranked among the best beaches in the Caribbean. Rent a golf cart to tour the island's scenic cliffs and viewpoints.
day_by_day.evening: Return via ferry to Cancun in time for a luxurious evening. Freshen up at the resort before heading out for dinner.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the resort before departure — fresh pastries, fruit, and espresso
meals.lunch: Lunch on Isla Mujeres at Mango Café or Olivia Restaurant — enjoy fresh Caribbean seafood, grilled fish, and tropical cocktails with views of Playa Norte
meals.dinner: Dinner at Gustino Italian Beachside Restaurant at JW Marriott Cancun — impeccable Italian cuisine with fresh pasta, premium wine selection, and ocean views

day_by_day.notes: Book a premium tour package for Isla Mujeres through the resort concierge for priority boarding and a private snorkeling guide. Bring waterproof camera or GoPro for underwater photography. Apply reef-safe sunscreen only.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day experience at Xel-Ha Eco Water Park & Snorkeling. Depart early via private transfer to this all-inclusive natural aquatic park where a freshwater river meets the Caribbean Sea. Snorkel through the lagoon, float down the lazy river, and explore underwater caves and cenotes teeming with tropical marine life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Xel-Ha — enjoy cliff jumping, hammocks over the water, bike rides through the jungle, and the iconic zip line. Take advantage of the all-inclusive food and beverage package included with premium admission.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Cancun via private transfer. Enjoy a relaxed evening at the resort — sunset swim, cocktails at the beach bar, and a low-key but luxurious dinner.

meals.breakfast: Grab-and-go breakfast box prepared by the resort before early departure
meals.lunch: All-inclusive dining at Xel-Ha — fresh seafood buffet, grilled meats, tropical fruits, and unlimited premium beverages included in the park package
meals.dinner: In-resort dining at the resort's premium signature restaurant — opt for the chef's tasting menu with wine pairing for a refined evening after an active day

day_by_day.notes: Xel-Ha is approximately 75 miles south of Cancun — arrange a private luxury transfer through the concierge (about 1.5 hours each way). Book premium all-inclusive tickets in advance. Wear water shoes for comfort in the river and cenotes.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a leisurely breakfast at the resort. Head to Playa Tortugas Beach Club for a premium Day Pass experience — one of the most vibrant and well-appointed beach clubs in the Hotel Zone. Secure a premium VIP daybed or cabana with dedicated service, infinity pool access, and direct beach access.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy the full beach club experience at Playa Tortugas — water sports activities such as paddleboarding, jet skiing, or parasailing available for an extra premium. Relax with curated cocktails, fresh fruit platters, and the lively yet sophisticated atmosphere of the Hotel Zone's most popular beach.
day_by_day.evening: The crown jewel of the trip — board the Sunset Catamaran Cruise along the Caribbean coastline. Enjoy the open premium bar, snorkeling stop at a coral reef, and a spectacular Caribbean sunset from the deck. Live music and an elegant on-board ambiance complete the experience.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely full resort breakfast — eggs station, smoked salmon, artisan cheeses, fresh juices, and specialty coffees
meals.lunch: Premium beach club lunch at Playa Tortugas — fresh ceviche, shrimp tacos, lobster rolls, and signature cocktails with ocean views
meals.dinner: Post-cruise dinner at Elefanta Restaurant & Lounge — an iconic upscale venue in the Hotel Zone with Asian-fusion cuisine, stunning ocean views, and a sophisticated cocktail program

day_by_day.notes: Book the VIP catamaran cruise package through the resort concierge for priority boarding and premium bar access. The sunset cruise typically departs around 4:30–5:00 PM — coordinate beach club departure accordingly. Bring a light layer for the evening sea breeze on the catamaran.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Cancun — wake up early for one last sunrise walk along the resort's private beach. Enjoy a premium farewell breakfast at the resort. Pack and prepare for checkout. If time permits, take a final dip in the Caribbean or a relaxing session in the resort's hydrotherapy pool.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on departure flight time, enjoy a final leisurely lunch at the resort or a nearby upscale beachfront restaurant. Private luxury transfer to Cancun International Airport arranged through the resort concierge.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Cancun International Airport. Relive the memories of an extraordinary premium Caribbean escape.

meals.breakfast: Grand farewell breakfast at the resort — full à la carte spread with champagne, smoked salmon, fresh pastries, tropical fruits, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Final lunch at La Habichuela Downtown or Lorenzillo's Live Lobster Restaurant — iconic Cancun dining institutions offering premium seafood and Mexican cuisine as a memorable last meal
meals.dinner: In-flight or at airport lounges depending on departure time — the resort concierge can arrange a premium farewell snack box for the journey

day_by_day.notes: Request a late checkout from the resort to maximize your final morning. Confirm private airport transfer timing with the concierge the night before. Allow at least 3 hours before international flight departure for airport procedures. Consider purchasing premium local artisan gifts or Tequila collections at the airport duty-free shops.
